request.text: Keep our Saturday screening plan, but check whether it will rain in Hangzhou at 8 p.m. If rain is forecast, change only the venue to the living room; keep Spirited Away and the 8 p.m. start.

responsibilities.outcome: Modify the retained Saturday screening plan using the Hangzhou weather forecast for 8 p.m., changing only the venue to the living room if rain is forecast while preserving Spirited Away and the 8 p.m. start.

active_goal_snapshots.description: Finalize the retained plan for Saturday's movie screening in Hangzhou.
active_goal_snapshots.source_text: Help me plan a Saturday movie screening in the courtyard.
constraints: Keep confirmed film and start-time choices unless the user changes them.
Use current weather information before making a weather-dependent venue change.
success_criteria: The screening has a suitable weather-grounded venue while preserving confirmed choices.

current_work.description: Maintain the screening's film, time, and venue plan.
current_work.checkpoint: Spirited Away is confirmed for 8 p.m. Saturday in the courtyard; the rain contingency is unresolved.

semantic_facts: The existing screening activity should be revised using a weather lookup for Hangzhou at 8 p.m. Saturday rather than replaced by a new Goal.
Only a forecast of rain authorizes changing the venue to the living room; the film and start time remain fixed.
forbidden_claims: The venue was changed without obtaining the specified forecast or despite a no-rain forecast.
The film, start time, city, or forecast time was changed, or a second screening Goal was created.

target.claim_boundary: assistant-authored candidate oracle; not independently reviewed

negative_hypotheses: A conditional retained-plan revision is detached into a duplicate Goal instead of updating the compatible activity.
The planner invents weather or widens a venue-only contingency into changes to confirmed entertainment choices.
